extensionDescription.message: Keep your homepage: every new tab opens your own navigation page, in private windows too.

noticeNotConfigured.message: No navigation page configured yet. Open the settings and enter the address you want every new tab to open.

noticeDisabled.message: HomeHold is turned off. New tabs will not be redirected until you switch it back on.

noticeReadFailed.message: Could not read the saved settings: $ERROR$

optionsTagline.message: Every new tab opens your own navigation page.

navUrlHelp.message: Must start with http:// or https://

enabledHelp.message: When off, new tabs show a short notice instead of redirecting.

invalidUrlMessage.message: Please enter an address starting with http:// or https://

readFailedMessage.message: Could not read the saved settings.

themeHelp.message: Match system follows your operating system's light or dark setting.

customNoticeTitleHelp.message: Shown on the page a new tab falls back to. Leave empty to use the default.

customNoticeMessageHelp.message: Replaces the explanation of why the tab was not redirected. Leave empty to use the default.

backupHelp.message: Export saves your settings to a file. Import applies a file immediately and replaces everything on this page.

importFailedMessage.message: That file is not a HomeHold settings file.

incognitoAllowed.message: Allowed to run in private windows

incognitoDenied.message: Not allowed to run in private windows

incognitoHelpDenied.message: To turn it on: about:addons → HomeHold → Permissions → enable "Run in Private Windows".

incognitoUnknown.message: Could not detect the private-window permission.
